outputComponents.text:
I've created a custom Android app icon for SMSpend. 

The design follows a **stationery-utility aesthetic**, using a flat, minimalist approach to convey privacy and reliability. It features a soft mint rupee (₹) glyph integrated into a geometric speech bubble, centered within a 70% safe zone to ensure it works perfectly with Android's adaptive icon system. The background is a solid, professional ink green (#0F3D32) with no gradients or 3D effects, keeping the focus on the app's core utility.

The icon is delivered as a 1024x1024 full-bleed square, ready for use as a foreground and background concept.
